input.quote: d. Use of Credit Data during the term of this Agreement. Client hereby grants to TrueLink the nonexclusive worldwide right and license to use, distribute, disseminate, license, resell, exploit, upload, display, copy and store Credit Data subject to the limitations set forth in and in accordance with the Non-Competition Agreement.
input.rationale: Compliant at the preferred position: the Agreement imposes no non-solicitation, no-hire or anti-poaching covenant on Mortgage Logic.com (Client). Searches for "solicit", "employ", "hire", "induce", "personnel" and "recruit" return only the unsolicited commercial e-mail provision (§ 7) and incidental references to employees in the access-restriction (§ 8(c)) and indemnity (§ 12) clauses, none of which restrict either party from hiring or soliciting the other's staff. Sections 8 (Client covenants) and 10 (Confidentiality) were read in full and contain no personnel restriction. The absence of any such covenant benefits our party, so this is compliant rather than missing. The duration and general-solicitation carve-out checks are inapplicable here rather than failed: there is no covenant whose term, scope or carve-outs could be measured, so they are not evidence of a deviation and no redline or counterparty comment is warranted. The cited paragraph is the document's nearest restrictive-covenant touchpoint only because it cross-references a separate Non-Competition Agreement; that cross-reference limits use of Credit Data, not hiring of personnel. Noted for the file and not raised as a deviation: the separately executed Non-Competition Agreement sits outside this document and should be reviewed under this rule in its own right if it contains personnel restrictions.
